name: Haza (Spain)
description: Square flag divided diagonally by a red band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, yellow above and white below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Haza (a castle on white within a bordure).
history: Municipal flag of Haza; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
